Why buying curtains & blinds for your windows?
Some may wonder, why go for both curtains & blinds? Well, because together, they do more than just look good. Here’s why combining them makes sense:

Layering = Flexibility!
: Blinds will control the light. Curtains will add softness & style.
Better For Insulation

Noise Reduction
: The extra layer helps dampen outside noise.
Enhanced Privacy: Especially useful for street-facing windows.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions
1. What are the differences between curtain blinds & regular curtains?

Curtain blinds offer more control over light & privacy compared to regular curtains. They also take up less space & are great for small or modern homes.
2. How do I clean my curtains & blinds?

2. How do I clean my curtains & blinds?
Most of our curtains are machine washable. Blinds should be wiped with a damp cloth regularly. Always follow the care label instructions for best results.

3. What are the benefits of using curtain blinds?
They provide excellent light control, save space, offer modern aesthetics, & are easier to maintain than traditional curtains.

4. How do I measure my window for curtain blinds?
Measure the width & height of your window or the area you want to cover. Our website has size guides & product dimensions for easy matching.
5. Do you offer custom-sized window curtains?

6. What types of curtain fabrics do you offer?
IKEA offers cotton, linen, polyester, velvet, sheer net, & blackout fabric options—each serving different needs like style, privacy, & insulation.

7. Are curtain blinds easy to install?
Yep! They’re all made with DIY in mind. Most come with clear instructions and all the hardware you’ll need to get them up without too much fuss.
